scientific_limitations: Uniform rotation of a fixed regular planar polygon only; no nonuniform angles, irregular polygons, or higher-dimensional boxes. An unindexed older orientation-law calculation is a residual priority risk. The 2014-01-23 date is the verified first public date of the specified motivating public tutorial, not a claim that the classical 1975 bounding-rectangle theory first appeared then.
title: Exact orientation law and arithmetic fluctuation trichotomy for bounding boxes of regular polygons
